character.description: Same accepted biped military mech, body-mounted cannon and foot toes face DOWN together, no arms. Preserve canonical base proportions, armor, olive/gray palette, amber optics, camera and asymmetric antenna.

idle.action: Stationary two-legged mechanical combat mech with body-mounted cannon always pointing south/down. Feet planted, only subtle piston compression and small torso settling; stable amber sensor. Preserve camera and exact armor layout. No arms or humanoid gestures.

walk.action: Complete six-pose mechanical biped walk cycle in place, aimed SOUTH/DOWN in all frames. 1: screen-left foot forward, right back; 2: left supports weight as right foot lifts into passing; 3: right foot moves down to contact and left starts lifting; 4: right foot forward, left back; 5: right supports weight as left lifts into passing; 6: left moves down toward contact returning smoothly to pose 1. Distinct full leg phases, no mirrored image substitutions. Keep torso, antenna, gun aim and armor stationary and identical; move only two leg joints and feet, slight piston compression. No arms or tracks.

attack.action: One body-mounted cannon shot, pointing south/down throughout: frame 1 neutral braced stance, frame 2 small hard-edged amber muzzle flash physically attached to cannon muzzle and barrel recoils slightly, frame 3 no flash and barrel slides forward, frame 4 exact neutral recovery. Feet planted, same two legs; no arms or handheld weapon. All recoil and flash remain inside the frame.

style: match the attached base/anchor reference image EXACTLY: same pixel density (logical pixel block size), same body proportions, same outline weight, same palette, same shading style, same level of detail. Do not restyle, do not change proportions, do not add or remove detail density.
